tenderEligibilityCriterionList.description:
Tenderers should not be associated, or have been associated in the
 past, directly or indirectly, with a firm or any of its affiliates which  have been engaged by the Purchaser to provide consulting services for the  preparation of the design, specifications, and other documents to be used  for the procurement of the goods to be purchased under this Invitation of  Tenders.


Bidders shall not be under a declaration of ineligibility for
 corrupt and fraudulent practices issued by Government of Karnataka

It shall be the responsibility of the Bidder to ensure credit of Tender Processing Fee and EMD into the respective receiving bank accounts of e-Procurement on or before the last date and time of bid submission.
EMD Payments through e-Payment mode shall be made as one single transaction and payments made in part are liable for rejection.
ALL OTHER TERMS AND CONDITIONS AS PER TENDER DOCUMENT

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer should be a manufacturer who must have manufactured, tested and supplied the items similar to the type specified in the Schedule of Requirements (Section V) of KGTTI Mangaluru, and KGTTI Belagavi, up to at least 80 % of the type of items mentioned in the Schedule of requirement and 40% of the type of items mentioned in the Schedule of requirement with respect to Micro and Small Enterprises of the quantity required in any one of the last 3 years 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26 . ( in any one of the last 2 years for Micro and Small Enterprises). The items offered and Supply must be of most recent series models incorporating the latest improvements in design. (Notarized true copy of the license/registration should produce)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/Supplier should have executed similar set-up at minimum 3 customer locations including at least one Government customer in the last 3 years. Purchase order copies of the same to be enclosed. Also, the bidder must have executed a turnkey project valued not less than INR 3 Crore (single PO) or more in the last 3 years.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder Supplier must have experience of setting up and running an Authorized training center (ATC) in at least 3 different places in India or other countries . The bidder must submit the documentary evidence to support the claim. In case an authorized dealer is quoting on behalf of the OEM, then the bidder can produce OEM credentials as evidence. Also, the bidder must obtain from the OEM that the OEM will recognize the center as an ATC and support the center in training activities

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/Supplier must have a customer base internationally and Supply of HVAC/RAC training equipment and should have supplied at least three similar pieces of equipment to Govt./Quasi Govt. training institutes in last 3 years industries/Manufacturing plants etc. The bidder must give copies of supply/Purchase orders to support the claim for RAC/HVAC Training Systems.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/Manufacturer s must have 5 years of experience in conducting business in the area of Technical & Vocational Education with respect to Annexures as mentioned in Schedule of Requirement. As evidence the manufacturer must submit Certificate of Incorporation, Orders obtained

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenderer shall also produce satisfactory work completion certificate(s) issued by the concerned government, public sector undertaking or private sector along with a certified copy of the previous supply orders issued to them by the concerned state. Central government departments and public sector units.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Tenders of tenderers quoting as authorized representative or authorized regular dealer of a manufacturer can also be considered provided the manufacturer furnishes authorization in the prescribed format assuring full guarantee and warranty obligations as per GCC and SCC and The tenderer, as authorized representative and should have a registered office in Karnataka and should have supplied, installed and commissioned satisfactorily at least 30% of the similar items as specified in the schedule of requirements under KGTTI Mangaluru,KGTTI Mangaluru,KGTTI Belagavi, in any one of the last 3 years 2023-24 ,2024-25 and 2025-26 in which 30% of quantity must have been supplied by the dealer

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: All tenderers that are quoting as authorized representatives of manufacturers shall be required to produce a notarized true copy of the authorizing manufacture s license/registration issued by the Competitive Authority. Government of Karnataka or equivalent license/registration issued by any other Government Authority in India to such manufacturer along with the authorization specified in (b) of Section VII.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer shall be a manufacturer or authorized dealer who have ISO certificate are eligible to participated in the tender. ISO Certifications for the Manufacturers of Training Equipment Manufacturers of the technical and vocational training equipment must submit their valid and current ISO certification valid until 3 months from the bid opening date. In case an authorized dealer is quoting on behalf of the OEM, then the bidder can produce OEM credentials as evidence. Bidder should have the following ISO Certifications ISO 9001:2015 ISO 14001:2015 ISO 45001:2018 Self attested copy of ISO / BIS Certification copy of the Manufacturer or Bidder.ISO Certifications for the Manufacturers of Training Equipment: Manufacturers of the technical and vocational training equipment must submit their valid and current ISO certification valid until 3 months from the bid opening date.Bidder should have ISO 9001 2015 Certification.Self attested copy of ISO / BIS Certification copy of the Manufacturer/ Bidder

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Bidder/OEM should upload original manufacturing license (MSME) & Factories registration certificate issued to them by the concerned State or Central Government certifying them as manufacturer of Machineries and Equipment.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The tenderer must have an office and a sales and service center located in India and shall have operated out of such office and such sales and service center for at least previous 3 (three) years i.e. 2023-24, 2024-25 and 2025-26 necessary proof to be produced

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Bids from any Manufacturer or Dealer from any of the banned /Restricted/ prohibited countries by Government of India will not be entertained and the Bidder must submit a notarized declaration

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Machineries and Equipments to be supplied shall be of reputed manufacturers, and Manufacturer s Authorization Forms (MAFs) must be submitted for at least 70% of equipments/Machineries mentioned in Schedule V. All such Machineries and Equipments shall conform to prevailing industry standards. A detailed brochure and a list specifying the make (brand) of the items proposed and Supply shall be included in the Schedule of Requirements and submitted as part of the bid documents. Furthermore, for 70% of the items for which MAFs are submitted, complete technical specifications must be available and verifiable on the respective Original Equipment Manufacturers (OEMs) official website

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: As per Schedule of Requirements (Schedule V), the Tenderers shall submit a bid for all items contained in the Schedule. In the circumstance that the Tenderer fails to do so, it shall be disqualified and treated as non responsive

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: If the bidder claims exemption from EMD under MSME, the manufacturer/authorized regular dealer must have manufactured and supplied at least 40% of the similar items in the quantities specified in Schedule V during the financial years 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26. Failure to meet this requirement shall render the bid non-responsive

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Installation, Commissioning and On-site Training: The installation and commissioning will be the responsibility of the supplier of the equipment. Two weeks training for each item at the KGTTI Mangaluru labs and Belagavi Labs for KGTTI engineers & technician to be provided by the supplier. The cost of Installation, Commissioning and training to be quoted in the price bid. The training should include operation & maintenance of the equipment supplied. (Consent letter must be submitted).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Teaching material All reading material, operating manuals, Experiments Manuals, workbooks required for using the training kit to be supplied along with the consignment and should mention accepted. (Consent letter must be submitted).

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: technical Requirements Updating of Digital Content KGTTI Mangaluru The OEM must guarantee ongoing digital content updates and system compatibility for at least three (3) years after installation. (Consent letter must be submitted).Experience of Engineer / Trainer for installation and training for KGTTI Mangaluru At least 2 trained personnel must be on permanent employment for more than 5 years with the OEM Authorized representative with experience in doing similar installation and training in RAC / HVAC technical training and for at least 5 clients/projects while in employment of the OEM / Authorized Representative.(Proof must be submitted)

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall submit copies of GST registration Certificate, recent GST clearance and GST returns filed in the last 3 years 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26 issued by the Commercial Taxes Department.

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: GST R-3B return filed certificate The Tenderer must submit turnover certificate for the previous three (3) financial years from a certified Chartered Accountant along with P & L accounts, Balance sheet for the last three years. The minimum Average Annual financial turnover for the last three financial years inclusive of all taxes should be as follows: Rs.25 Crores for OEMs/Authorized Dealers During the last three financial years 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26. Rs.12.5 Crores for Micro and Small Enterprises During the last three financial years 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: Positive Net worth Statement certified by CA in each of the last 3 FY (2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26) and Profit Declaration Statement by Tenderer

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: The Tenderer shall produce copy of its Income Tax returns for the last three financial years i.e., FYs 2023-24 , 2024-25 and 2025-26

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: In case any Tenderer is found to have been disqualified/blacklisted/suspended from empanelment or from participation in any tender from Government or Quasi Government agency, in the Union of India, such Tenderers would stand automatically disqualified from participation in this tender. The Tenderer shall give a declaration as given in Annexure-1

tenderTechnicalCriterionDocumentList.documentName: Others -- As per the technical criterion

tenderTechnicalCriterionList.description: technical bid documents should be uploaded and also hardcopy of all documents uploaded by the Tenderer in the e-procurement portal should be submitted to KGMSDC Society through Speed Post to The Member Secretary & Commissioner, Society for KGMSDC, Kaushalya Bhavan Campus, Dairy Circle, BG Road, Bangalore-29 on or before the opening of Technical Bids through e-portal.
